scope: Candidate2 diagnostic only; root operated two owned native processes on one Mac. Statements below preserve root-reported actual UI observations; no automated script witnessed the clicks.

observations.fact: Both READY and START worked; generated_river started with normal resources. The French remote player controls P3, the British host controls P1.
observations.savedEvidenceLimit: The first saved client match frame is at 27.400068s; no saved READY/START lobby frame is included.

observations.fact: P3 Train 1 French worker deducted 120 food from 300 to 180, and reserved one population slot.
P1 Train 1 British settler deducted 100 food from 300 to 200.
observations.savedEvidenceLimit: The saved host PNG/JSON shows 200 food and one reserved villager job; its 300-food initial state is in the replay initial anchor rather than a host PNG.

observations.fact: Root opened Esc local menu and observed client world time progress from about 45 to 62.8 seconds while sharedPaused remained false.
observations.savedEvidenceLimit: The archived 62.7996139s capture has localMenuPaused=true/sharedPaused=false. No saved frame of the approximately 45s starting point is present.

observations.fact: Host shared pause stopped both worlds at the same immutable snapshot; client later closed its local menu while the shared pause remained.
observations.savedEvidenceLimit: This confirms these captured snapshots. It does not measure pause timing or validate a physical network.

observations.fact: Client resumed the shared match, selected a worker with V and issued an accepted right-click Move.
observations.savedEvidenceLimit: Metadata shows actor104 Move destination; root supplied the actual V/right-click observations. No command animation timing claim is made.

observations.fact: Root suspended the owned client process with SIGSTOP for 18 seconds and used try/finally SIGCONT. Root observed the host after reconnection; no saved host screenshot exists during the outage itself.
observations.savedEvidenceLimit: This is an owned-process suspend test on one Mac, not Wi-Fi/link failure or two-machine network validation.

observations.fact: Client rejoined the same match while shared-paused; host and client later show the same stopped step/time/cursor and projection.
observations.savedEvidenceLimit: The client capture after SIGCONT initially says connected=false; the later client capture has connected=true. Both retain the same MatchId. No claim of a saved host outage frame is made.

observations.fact: Host SAVE REPLAY wrote the host-only recording. Subsequent saves updated the same segment file; the final archived file has finishReason menu_exit.
observations.savedEvidenceLimit: The final file is the later closed segment; earlier manual prefix bytes were not separately retained and are not claimed here.

observations.fact: Client LEAVE returned to the main menu. Host resumed and the remote P3 resigned. Candidate2 still displayed a stale waiting-to-reconnect label after this permanent leave; this is retained as a diagnostic.
observations.savedEvidenceLimit: No saved client main-menu frame is present. The stale label is not reported as correct UI; Candidate3 is a separate candidate and requires its own evidence.
